description: Add a dedicated non-root user and switch to it using the USER instruction in the Dockerfile. Create the user with appropriate permissions and ensure the application runs under that user context.

example.after:
FROM openjdk:11-jre-slim
# Create a non-root user
RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 appgroup && \
    adduser --system --uid 1001 --gid 1001 appuser
# Switch to the non-root user
USER appuser:appgroup
# Rest of the Dockerfile...

fix_pattern.instructions: Add a dedicated non-root user and switch to it using the USER instruction in the Dockerfile. Create the user with appropriate permissions and ensure the application runs under that user context.
